lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1803 — the HUD belongs to Tartaria

Two passes, accepted together by the owner as one visual release.

DEPTH SAYS PRESSABLE, COLOUR SAYS MEANING (OTA-1802). The compact controls
carried the language on one layer only — the inner sheen — while TButton
carried it on two, so a small button read flat beside a large one that read
raised. The depth pair is repointed at its own named tokens
(controlRaisedLit / controlRaisedDark), roughly doubling the measured
Rec.709 luminance gradient on the resting and pressed states (96 -> 171,
93 -> 168, 58 -> 134, 56 -> 131), and 65 governed call sites across eleven
screens now take it through tControlDepth / tFilledGold. The rule that made
the pass safe is asserted, not assumed: depth means pressability, semantic
colour means meaning, and the suite proves the two axes stay independent.
The intentionally flat controls stay flat — that boundary is a negative
test, not an oversight. Three ringless controls traded 1dp of padding for
1dp of border so their outer height is byte-identical to before, which also
ends a pre-existing 2dp jitter on World's ACCEPT.

THE PANEL IS BUILT, NOT DRAWN ON. Exploration's four families — player,
enemy, location/scene and the transcript — take a single hairline gold rim
(panelRim at 0.26) plus the existing TCorners registration. Framing is
structural grouping and is deliberately NOT the button treatment; the two
languages are kept apart by construction, because panelFrame contributes
borderWidth, borderColor and borderRadius and nothing else. No width, no
margin, no padding, no flex, no minHeight, no position — so the outer flex
geometry cannot move, and only 2dp of inner width is spent per panel.

THE FACTION IS IN THE ROOM. FactionWatermark places the player's own crest
behind the transcript at 0.055 opacity with an 8% inset, contained and
centred from the measured panel via containCrestField. It belongs to the
PANEL, not to the log: an absolutely positioned sibling that joins no
layout, adds no scroll extent, re-measures only when the panel actually
changes, and takes no touch. A faction with no art renders nothing at all.

VERIFIED AT THE SMALLEST PHONE. The existing viewport harness is height-only
and cannot express this, so the 320x568 proof composes each panel's real
style and asserts the residue after removing the frame's three keys equals
the pre-frame style exactly; the flex track still divides (320 - 6) / 2 =
157 per column, with a 155 content box. The watermark is proven contained,
centred, inert to touch and outside the scrolling content for all nine
factions. Jest runs no Yoga, so what is proven is that the treatment is
incapable of moving a box — stated plainly in the suite rather than dressed
up as a measurement.

Full surface 1341/1341 suites, 13,920 tests, 3 skipped. 20/20 gates,
typecheck:ci clean, typecheck:tests at baseline 201 with no growth, lint
clean. Negative controls red-then-green throughout; none committed.

trackBtn and selectAllBtn remain deliberately flat, deferred with the
owner's acceptance.
